name: Kotofuki Erii
source:
Hobbies: Doing drugs, having sex
Likes: Sex, live concerts
Dislikes: Being alone

The vocalist of the band "Cerberus Guard 69", which usually performs in a music club located  a back street a just off  Chuo street in Chisakura town. Erii's unique appearance attracts many fans, she looks like a Western-type doll. She is a captivating young woman with a decadent atmosphere, whose speech and behavior are strange, and the thoughts she shares with others are devastating.

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/mdb-dvd2/cha/mdbdvd_cha13.htm]official website[/url].]
